title: Story Toolkit scope specification
$comment: A ScopeSpec names files and exact allowed source ranges against a baseline hash. Ranges are half-open UTF-8 byte ranges [start, end) of the baseline file and must fall on character boundaries. Boundary rule: a range owns both boundaries, so an edit may insert text at start or at end; replacing a range's bytes can always be written as an insertion at its start, so no narrower rule is observable. An empty range [p, p) permits insertion at p only. Overlapping and touching ranges merge. A file listed without ranges may change freely, including deletion; ranges: [] allows no change. Changed files the scope does not list are out of scope. A file new since the baseline is listed with the SHA-256 of empty content.

baseline-hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the file's bytes in the baseline revision; the empty-content hash for a file new since the baseline.

ranges.description: Allowed half-open UTF-8 byte ranges [start, end) of the baseline file. Each range owns both boundaries (insertion at start or end is allowed); an empty range is one insertion point. Omit to allow any change to the file, including deletion.

markers.description: Whether an edit may add, remove or rename <!-- story-scene --> and <!-- story-beat --> markers inside its ranges. Default locked.

restriction.description: The author's restriction for a dialogue edit. dialogue: quoted content only; dialogue-and-tags: quoted content plus speech tags and action beats. Advisory only: quote detection may warn about a change, but the ranges decide the scope.
